summary: Implementation already satisfies the plan requirements: `require_api_token` uses constant-time `hmac.compare_digest`, preserves existing 503 `API_TOKEN_NOT_CONFIGURED` and 401 `UNAUTHORIZED` plus `WWW-Authenticate` behavior, and workspace metadata routes requiring auth (`POST /v1/workspaces`, `POST /v2/workspaces`, workspace list/overview/get/events/stale-reasons, and `/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/secret-leases`) are router-protected in `src/awf/api/routes/workspaces.py`. Contract tests (`test_deps.py`, `test_workspaces.py`, `test_surface_metadata_alignment.py`) assert auth-required and public `/healthz`/`/readyz` behavior, and the AWF validation artifact shows required focused tests and static checks passing.
